objective: Read-only design audit of an E-only AR lattice-planning lead for relational_cnl_v1 shared-model generation/editing.

scope.scope_note: A helper briefly opened a mixed-split aggregate before noticing it included heldout entries, stopped, and excluded it. No heldout source rows were explicitly inspected, analyzed, or used.
scope.current_job_note: Parent reports one first-seen case from Slurm 607872 completed G, strict E-reference, and closed-loop successfully with the generic lead; raw independent re-audit and full cohort are pending. This report does not independently verify that result.

assessment.fit_to_goal: A concise E lead that states the source and desired a,b,c lengths before CRYSTAL_START is a better operational match to interleaved AR reasoning followed by crystal-body generation than the current generic sentence.
assessment.necessity: Not established. The old B32 diagnostic supports the hypothesis, while the newly reported generic-lead success is counterevidence. Wait for the current full-cohort raw audit before spending another training budget.
assessment.claim_boundary: This tests a supervised, visible calculation plan; it does not establish hidden reasoning, prove the plan causes every edit failure, or support a universal-infeasibility claim.

existing_flow.task: E prompt includes source CNL, source-fact answer, then the scale-only instruction. The E lead target is currently a generic sentence.
existing_flow.training: model.pack supervises lead tokens as AR text. clean_crystal_ar_weight=1.0 adds auxiliary next-token loss on the crystal body; it does not create an inference-time planner.
existing_flow.inference: generate() calls greedy model.text(..., trigger=true) until CRYSTAL_START, then passes the generated lead in the full context to model.crystal(). Hybrid crystal sampling generates all K=2560 raw tokens.
existing_flow.actual_loop: Actual E is conditioned on the generated C1 and model-generated Q1 answer; actual C2 is scored against that C1. Q2 sees the E lead as context, so Q2 must remain separate from strict E scoring.
existing_flow.naming: No run.emit function is present in the active joint source; generate() is the relevant entry point.

candidate_intervention.treatment: Change only the E lead target to a short natural-language template naming original a,b,c, requested factor, and desired a,b,c before CRYSTAL_START. Keep G lead, G/Q prompts and targets, crystal bodies, sampler, decoder, and scorer fixed.
candidate_intervention.labels: Build training lead labels from the existing exact source plans and Decimal 1.05/0.95 target plans. Keep all six values in the lead; do not round through Q1 prose, which formats lattice lengths to two decimals.
candidate_intervention.inference: At evaluation, obtain the lead only from free-running model.text(..., trigger=true). Do not insert target plans/values into the E prompt, compute a correction externally, or repair the generated body.
candidate_intervention.crystal_body: Continue sampling all raw K tokens through the unchanged hybrid crystal branch and existing decoder/scorer; no AR-body fallback or post-hoc edit.

smallest_controlled_pilot.trigger: Proceed only if the completed generic-lead full-cohort/raw audit leaves recurring strict E failures, especially physically valid body-preserving outputs with wrong exact lattice values. If the generic model holds up, stop here.
smallest_controlled_pilot.data: Train both arms on the same reviewed train32 rows and variants. Keep source16 held out of training and tuning; open it once for evaluation only after both checkpoints, code, seeds, and metrics are frozen.
smallest_controlled_pilot.matched_configuration: Use the same clean initial fingerprint, 1.5B model revision, clean_crystal_ar_weight=1.0, block size 32, K=2560, MAXLEN=8192, 512 updates, seed 17, effective batch 4, optimizer/scheduler, task exposure, and confidence sampler. The active joint runner currently points to the old 24-row data directory, so a future 32-row comparison must pin the reviewed scaled32 records explicitly; do not treat the current run as a train32 baseline.
smallest_controlled_pilot.evaluation: Run the existing reference-E and actual G/read/edit/read evaluator on identical heldout cases and per-case sampler seeds. Report lead numeric accuracy, E_reference, E_actual, G, Q1, Q2, closed-loop, physical audit, exact length error, and every failure in the denominator. Keep E_reference as the paired E mechanism check and the full loop as the end-to-end check.

confounds_and_controls: Teacher forcing: training lead CE conditions on gold preceding tokens, while inference free-runs the plan. Score the generated six values at inference; do not substitute teacher-forced lead accuracy.

Generated-C1 shift: training plans derive from reference C1/source plans, while actual E sees sampled C1 and generated Q1. In the full loop, require the plan's original values to match that actual C1 and desired values to match its exact requested scale.
Q2 copying: actual Q2 context includes the plan lead. Score Q2 against the generated C2 audit, and never count Q2 alone as evidence that C2 is correct.
Lead length and capacity: model.text has a 160-token trigger limit. Keep the plan concise, record lead lengths, and rerun the static pack/MAXLEN audit before training.
Shared-weight spillover: G/Q task data and scoring stay fixed, but E-only updates still change shared weights. Treat G/Q shifts as measured spillovers, not assumed invariants.

acceptance_gates.preflight: Confirm exact train32/heldout16 separation, identical arm initialization and training/sampling receipts, plan labels from train source plans only, and capacity fit without truncation.
acceptance_gates.mechanism: On the sealed 16-case evaluation, report whether the free-running E lead states all original and desired values exactly before CRYSTAL_START; retain failed/malformed leads in the denominator.
acceptance_gates.body_edit: Use unchanged strict grade_edit: exact target lengths, unchanged non-lattice fields, whole-geometry scale, and passing physical audit. Any missing condition is an E failure.
acceptance_gates.screening_rule: Pre-register a continuation threshold before opening heldout results; a practical pilot screen is at least 3 net paired gains in strict E_reference out of 16, plus at least one net full-loop gain, with no material G/Q regression. This is a screening gate only, not a statistical or generalization claim.
acceptance_gates.interpretation: If G rarely yields an auditable C1, report the full-loop effect as unresolved and use paired E_reference results only as the narrower mechanism evidence.

secondary_method.option: Freeze unchanged body spans and resample only the lattice sentence/values with an inpainting or constrained-mask path.
secondary_method.tradeoff: Could avoid regenerating stable orbit/correction text, but changes the crystal sampler and requires reliable span handling for variable-length numeric text. Keep it as a separate method change after the E-lead pilot.

Actual loop uses generated C1 and Q1 for E, and includes the E lead in Q2 context.
